en: A monochrome postcard showing a general panoramic view of Santiago de Compostela with tiled rooftops in the foreground and the large Baroque cathedral complex dominating the skyline. The twin towers and central façade of the basilica are clearly visible, along with surrounding historic buildings. Printed caption text appears at the top in Spanish, and a small library credit appears at the bottom left.
